hero_desc: Every cut is a statement. Every line is intentional. Experience barbering elevated to art.
story_p1: Born from a passion for precision and personal style, Thade Adhikari has spent over a decade mastering the blade. Every session is a ritual — a conversation between craft and identity.
story_p2: From the classic fade to the boldest modern cuts, each service is delivered with patience, skill, and an obsession for detail that only comes from true dedication to the craft.
signature_p1: Our house signature — a sculpted mid-fade with a defined hard part and textured crop on top. Engineered for men who want structure without sacrifice, edge without effort.
signature_p2: Finished with a hot towel, straight razor lineup, and premium styling. One cut. Total transformation.
testi1_text: Never thought a haircut could change how I carry myself. Thade took one look and knew exactly what I needed. Left the chair a completely different man.
testi2_text: The cleanest fade I've ever had. Precise, professional, and the vibe is immaculate. This is my spot forever. No one else touches my hair.
